parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description:
The ID of the DNS record. <props="china">To obtain the ID, call the [DescribeDomainRecords](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation.</props>
<props="intl">To obtain the ID, call the [DescribeDomainRecords](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation.</props>
